# synchronicity.one

> synchronicity.one sp. z o. o. builds and runs the systems an organisation depends on, on open source software and on servers the client owns. Based in Lublin, Poland. The Polish language counterpart of this company is 41.pl.

## What we do

- Your own private cloud: mail, files, calendars and chat on Nextcloud or another open source stack, dedicated to a single organisation. Custom software when nothing off the shelf fits.
- Programming that fills the gaps: scripts, API integrations, webhooks, plugins, calculators and forms.
- Automation that removes manual work: scheduled reports, data moving between systems, unattended processes.
- AI on your own data: LLMs running against the client's own documents and records on servers they control, and symbolic AI where an answer has to be repeatable and explainable.
- Websites and online stores: static sites through to WP/Woo shops, built for speed and measured against Core Web Vitals.
- Infrastructure that stays up: Linux servers, updates, monitoring and encrypted backups.
